- Claude Code 2.1.292 support: the four new state files from Claude Code 2.1.289 (`daemon.lock`, `daemon.status.json`, `gh-pr-status-cache.json`, `mcp-needs-auth-cache.json`) are known machine state and are skipped without a warning (#21)
- The unknown-files warning now says only those files are left out, so it no longer reads as if the whole setup was not saved

Install or update: `npm install -g agentnomad@latest` (Node.js 22.13 or newer).
